Officer's narrative
Officers were dispatched to a two-vehicle collision on a roadway in Houston, Texas, where a low-speed head-on
collision had occurred. Driver 1 and Driver 2 were both present at the scene, along with one Passenger seated in
Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported neck and back strain and said the impact was brief but jarring. Driver 2 and two
independent witnesses stated that the collision happened in the manner Driver 1 described, and scene photographs
are consistent with those accounts. Damage to the front end of both vehicles is largely in line with the reported impact
speed and angle. Officers confirmed that Driver 1 was in the vehicle at the time of the crash, and Driver 1 is listed as
a named driver on the applicable policy. Nothing observed at the scene or reported by those involved suggested prior
damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 was evaluated at the scene and transported for furtehr examination as a
precaution.
